name: Shape-from-Shading for old photos with harsh side-lighting

inputs.description: 1970s family photo with harsh side-window lighting — depth models fail here

detail_enhancement_vs_depth_model.unit: pct more surface detail on textured surfaces

disposition_if_pass: keep_conditional (supplemental geometry channel for old photos)
notes: Shape-from-Shading works where multi-view fails: single old photos with harsh side-lighting produce more surface detail than any depth model. For multi-image input, photometric stereo gives better results. DeepPS2 allows 2-image input without ground truth.
